notes: Morning = specialty library only (no seasons). Night = creative sky pack by default; holidays + full moon still override. Current-season storefront only mixes into creatives (never wrong-season). Holiday windows may rotate multiple holiday plates. Full moon image ONLY on actual full-moon nights. HARD RULE (Founder 2026-08-06): every night creative must include a clear Sacred Ground visual anchor IN THE PHOTO (storefront / logo-sun bat-signal / glowing SACRED GROUND in landscape). Pure generic aurora/sky is not enough. Overlay logo+footer still apply but do not replace in-photo SG identity. Active creative_pool = sg_identity pass only; failures live in creative_pool_needs_sg_identity until regenerated. See docs/NIGHT-CREATIVES.md and .cursor/rules/night-image-sacred-ground.mdc.

daytime.how_it_works: Specialty library images only. No seasonal or holiday overlays for morning posts.

nighttime.base_style: Sacred Ground night creatives MUST show Sacred Ground in the picture: storefront, circular logo/folk-art sun as sky or moon mark, bat-signal searchlights, or glowing SACRED GROUND in landscape — plus eggplant-purple storefront seasonals mixed into the creative pool. Pure northern lights / Milky Way / star trails with no SG cue are forbidden. When a storefront plate is used: tan stone facade, deep EGGPLANT PURPLE awnings, white SACRED GROUND lettering with NO swoosh between the words.
nighttime.awning_swoosh: none — leave blank eggplant space between SACRED and GROUND

full_moon.source_note: Dedicated full-moon storefront. Never use on non-full-moon nights.

nighttime.how_it_combines: Priority: (1) full moon night → full-moon image only; (2) holiday window → rotate that holiday’s urls (Christmas includes forest tree); (3) else rotate creative night skies by day among sg_identity=pass plates only; current-season storefront at most every 5th creative-mode night and never after a storefront streak. Founder Screenshot exteriors are not part of the night pool. Events stay in caption. Week-ahead horizon is 2 days. Plates in creative_pool_needs_sg_identity are excluded until regenerated. creative_pool_ready_local holds SG-pass regenerations awaiting WP upload.
nighttime.sg_identity_rule: Every week_ahead night plate needs an in-photo Sacred Ground anchor. sg_identity must be pass for creative_pool entries. Overlays alone are not enough.
